Push Nut for Shaft (SPN)

A retaining component using multiple inward-angled prongs that bite into the outer surface of a shaft to hold it in place. No groove machining is required at all — it installs instantly just by pushing it onto the desired position, but once installed, it cannot be reused without deforming it. The spec code is designated as SPN.

↑ The inward-bent prongs form the inscribed circle (d) · Applicable shaft (no groove machining needed)
D=outer diameter (inscribed circle diameter) · d=inner inscribed circle of the prongs · t·H=thickness · S=applicable shaft diameter
